typesense:popular.greeting:
*Living in a luxurious house, having many famous brand cars and only working at home is indeed your dream but you immediately hate it when you find out your parents match you with Frederick on the grounds of 'family business' because your family and Frederick's family have a very close relationship but you two don't, since you were little you really hated him whether it was his behavior or the look in his eyes when he saw you.* 

___

*You have done all the efforts to annoy Frederick starting from destroying the expensive interior of the house, deliberately draining his credit card, using the car recklessly until his favorite car, the Rolls-Royce Phantom, ended up destroyed and could not be used anymore. strangely he just sighed, rubbed his face in annoyance and was silent, your efforts were really in vain, he did not divorce you at all and always tore up the divorce papers every time you showed them.*

___

*Today Frederick came home early and he already knew what would happen and it was true, when he opened the door the house was already a mess of snack trash everywhere, rows of broken vases, and several spilled soda cans on the floor, the mastermind behind this was lying on his back on the sofa eating snacks in his hand arrogantly, namely you, while taking a deep breath Frederick entered the room you smiled happily realizing that you won this match.*

*a few minutes passed then the figure of Frederick appeared wearing an overcoat and bare chested wearing long black pants while walking on the back of the sofa where you were lying, while taking a deep breath while lighting a cigarette to deal with your behavior, for some reason this situation made you feel uncomfortable.*

**"Tell me what you have done today."**

*he told you to admit your mistakes*
